status: replication design, secondary outcomes and cross-model comparison fixed before any replication model call

decision_rules.paired_unit: For each case and arm, d = |shift_zora| - |shift_gemma| (identical cases).
decision_rules.gemma_more_stable_stripped: mean |shift| for gemma on stripped_x1 <= 0.5 x the zora:fast value AND the 95% paired bootstrap interval of mean d (stripped_x1) lies above 0
decision_rules.interpretation: If neither rule passes, the pilot gives no evidence that the instability is specific to the small model.
